propositions: The integration idempotency test patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and related absence/tombstone/comment operations into binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy unchanged pass, but its ability to detect regressions in clear_absent's timestamp handling is weakened.
The idempotency oracle must patch _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle modules to restore full blast radius and catch any future unconditional timestamp stamping in moved operations.
Unit-tier tests in test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence already pin the clear_absent no-stamp contract, containing the coverage risk at a lower tier.
